audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Jax levels 2 and 3 and calls level 1 even, while the whys beside them say the opposite: whys[0] 'your Q-Vital poke lands free', whys[1] 'lands a guaranteed Vital before he has a reliable dodge tool', whys[2] 'his Counter Strike is still single-rank and easy to bait'. The 'early' text is even more explicit: 'Levels 1-3 are yours and you should press them'. Packet levelChart: Fiora / Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Jax / Jax.
audit.why: Counter Strike is not available at level 1 and is 17s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his lane kit — while Relentless Assault has no attack-speed ramp yet. Fiora's Bladework crit onto a Vital lands with no dodge answer. From 4 onward the E is reliably up for each trade, and from one item Trinity plus on-hit sustain outpace her burst.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2 and 3 -> Fiora; 4-5 and 6 stay Skill; first item and 2+ items stay Jax. Flipped as one atomic group in both layers.

audit.why: Four spikes, correctly ordered, and spikes[1] already carries a real sequence — bait the E, wait the dodge window, then ultimate. Added the 17s rank-1 Counter Strike figure so the bait has a clock; the packet already counted six sequencing cues here, the most in this slice.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike 17/15/13/11/9s; Leap Strike 8s falling to 6s; Empower 7s falling to 3s; Grandmaster-at-Arms 110/100/90s.

audit.why: The decisive interaction is stated correctly in three places: Counter Strike stuns surrounding enemies when it ends, so it is an immobilise, so Riposte blocking it upgrades Fiora's stab to a stun — wants.you[2] and mid both say this. Nothing on the page claims a parry works on the dodge itself, which would have been the easy mistake.

audit.whatIsWrong: Empower is described only as part of a 'Q-W burst'. Its auto-attack reset — the actual tell for his damage — is never named.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags autoreset-burst-tell for this matchup. Empower falls to a 3s cooldown at rank 5 and resets his attack, so the wind-up on the swing is the cue to step back, not the cast bar.
audit.corrected: Named the Empower reset inside wants.foe[2] and the Waste-W don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Build armor' but its body is the generic 'Jax wastes Counter Strike' line, so the armour advice never lands. It also matters that most of his damage is physical while Grandmaster-at-Arms adds magic on every third strike.
audit.why: Kit text on R: 'Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage ... increasing his Armor and Magic Resist'. So Plated Steelcaps (already prescribed in report[8]) covers the bulk but not the third-strike magic, and his ultimate makes him tankier the longer the fight runs — which is exactly why the late-game don't matters.
audit.corrected: Gave the armour do a real body, and gave 'Fight him even late' the actual reason: his ultimate stacks resistances on top of ramping attack speed.

audit.why: Packet suspectName 'Hold Counter Strike' is a FALSE POSITIVE — the ability name is correct and the flagged token is just the verb in front of it. No change.

edits.before: Even-ish at 6 — his Counter Strike can dodge your Q and E autos and stun, so the all-in comes down to baiting it out first.
edits.after: Even from 4 — Counter Strike dodges your Q and E autos then stuns, so every trade comes down to baiting it out first.

edits.before: Use Q-W to gap-close past your spacing and force fights while his Counter Strike is up
edits.after: Leap Strike into an Empower reset to gap-close past your spacing while Counter Strike is up

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Jax, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 and lasts about 2s — feint a step, let it expire, then commit your Q and the Vital.

edits.before: Jax wastes Counter Strike — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His empowered hits are physical until R's third-strike magic.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Grandmaster-at-Arms adds armour and MR on top of his ramping DPS.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Empower is a 3s auto-reset at max rank — parry the Counter Strike stun instead and the stun goes back on him.

notes: Chart flipped to match its own whys and the packet: the page said Jax wins levels 2 and 3 while the early text told the player 'Levels 1-3 are yours and you should press them'. The content layer here is otherwise one of the better ones in this slice — it already had the bait-the-E sequence, the parried-stun interaction, and an honest late game. Unverified and left alone deliberately: the page says Counter Strike 'dodges your Q and E autos'. Riot's text is 'dodge all incoming attacks', which in-game means basic attacks — Bladework's two attacks are basic attacks and clearly dodged, but Lunge is a spell cast and may not be. I could not confirm from the kit files which way Lunge resolves, so I did not touch that claim. It is worth a definitive answer because 'can he dodge your Q' changes the entire bait sequence.
